product.name: Unified Social Analytics and Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that consolidates paid and organic social media analytics and automates workflows across multiple social networks to measure content ROI and optimize social media management.

product.name: Social A/B Testing
product.description: A tool for running and managing A/B tests on social media content to identify the most effective creative and messaging for Facebook and Instagram audiences.

product.name: Organic Social Scheduling
product.description: A social media scheduling tool that manages complex posting schedules across multiple profiles, time zones, and networks with live post previews and content recirculation.

product.name: Paid Social Management and Amplification
product.description: A suite for managing paid social campaigns, including boosting posts, running advanced campaigns, A/B testing ads, and optimizing for conversions on platforms like Facebook and Instagram.

product.name: Free Social Media Analytics
product.description: A free analytics service offering customizable dashboards with hundreds of paid and organic social media metrics across multiple networks.

product.name: Content Posting Options and Intelligent Scheduler
product.description: Tools for publishing social media content either manually or using intelligent scheduling based on rules, fanpage data, and content lifecycle.
